import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Done: the `:` picker deadlock is fixed and CI is green. The full epic closeout (remaining panel tests/fixtures + bead close) is not done — details below.

Root cause: `BobProcessClient.run` read stdout/stderr only after the child exited. A pipe holds 64 KiB; `capture-complete --all-tasks` for `:` returns 592 candidates / ~246 KB, so `bob` blocked in `write(2)` forever and the call timed out after 20s. Fixed by draining both pipes on background readers from launch and resuming only after exit + both EOFs; timeout now covers the whole span.

Changed in bob-mac-capture (commit `8b40e08`):
- `Sources/CaptureCore/BobProcessClient.swift` — new `ProcessOutputDrain`, concurrent drain, all existing guards kept.
- `Tests/Fixtures/fake-bob` — `FAKE_BOB_BULK_*` switches + `FAKE_BOB_TASK_LINK_ROWS` bulk `task_link` synthesis.
- `Tests/CaptureCoreTests/BobProcessClientTests.swift` — 1 MiB/256 KiB deadlock test + 600-row decode test.
- `Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/CapturePanelModelTests.swift` — vault-sized `:` picker test + chip-reopen-without-refetch test.
- `Sources/BobMacCapture/CapturePanelModel.swift` — chip refetch only when `cursor > r.start + 1` for `.taskLink`.
- `CapturePickerView.swift`, `CapturePanelView.swift` — all `Text + Text` rewritten to interpolated `Text("…\(Text(…))…")`; no `+ Text(` remains.

Verified:
- Mac harness on Bryan's real vault: `:` → 592 candidates in 0.104s, 55 sections, filters 6–25ms; `:gtd` → 166 rows; `Buy milk\n\n:` → 592 rows. No timeouts.
- `just format-lint build` clean (no `'+' was deprecated`); `Build complete!`.
- CI run `36768490032` fully green (Lint, Build, Test, Bundle, Verify, Launch smoke, Install).

To confirm in the real app: on the Mac, run `gg` in `~/projects/github/bbugyi200/bob-mac-capture` to pull, rebuild, reinstall; open the panel and type `:`. The Open Tasks card should appear immediately with the whole vault.

Remaining (not done this turn): plan step 6's full panel-test matrix and real-`bob` fixtures (Buy-milk parse/complete, `capture-task-id` success/dup, capture submit JSONs — I generated the real outputs in `/tmp` but did not write fixture files or wire them into fake-bob), then a second CI run and epic `bob-cli-2v` closeout with harness numbers. I merged steps 2–3/5/7 into one commit to keep the new chip test green; the plan asked for two. `bob-cli` needed no code change. The bead is still open; reopen with `sase bead open bob-cli-2v` if the app still misbehaves.
Epic bob-cli-2v is closed and the full closeout is done.

Root cause: `BobProcessClient.run` read stdout/stderr only inside `process.terminationHandler`, after the child exited. A pipe holds 64 KiB, but `capture-complete --all-tasks` for `:` returns ~591 candidates / ~246 KB of JSON, so `bob` blocked in `write(2)`, never exited, and the call hung until the 20 s timeout threw `timedOut`. That is why the panel showed "Pick any open task — press Tab to browse" with no picker card, while the `^` picker (a few KiB) worked.

What was implemented (bob-mac-capture, on top of `6191dec`):
- `8b40e08` — concurrent stdout/stderr drain from launch via a private `ProcessOutputDrain` (group entered before launch, resume only after exit + both EOFs, timeout covering the whole span); vault-sized regression tests (1 MiB/256 KiB drain, 600-row decode, 600-row end-to-end picker); chip-reopen without the redundant 246 KB refetch; all `Text + Text` rewritten to the macOS 26 interpolated form.
- `e7cb242` — 15 fake-bob-driven panel tests (batch open at `{10,11}`, selection chip, filter keystrokes run no subprocess, single completion for bare `:`, fast-typed `:dee` refetch, Return / Shift-Return / Command-Return with recorded-`capture`-argv submit asserts, Backspace, two-stage Escape, ID-less prefill/splice/`=`/submit/duplicate-error) plus 6 fixtures generated by a real `bob` on the worked-example vault (`BOB_NOW` pinned, sanity-checked byte-identical to `task-link-complete-full.json`): Buy-milk parse/complete, task-id success/duplicate (exit 1), capture dry-run/submit for both links.
- `9de8eb9` — one correction: fast-typed `:dee` presents partial (real bob answers `{0,4}`, never matching the `{0,1}` refetch), which the first CI run caught.

Verification (all observed, nothing inferred): mac harness on Bryan's live vault — `:` → 591 candidates in 0.031 s, 55 sections, filters 6–26 ms; `:gtd` → 166 rows; batch → 591 rows; no timeouts. `just format-lint build` clean with no `deprecated` warnings. macOS 26 SwiftPM run **36770569427** fully green (Lint, Build, Test, Bundle, Verify, Launch smoke, Install). bob-cli itself needed no code change and is untouched. Epic plan `202609/task_link_picker.md` marked `done` (`bd7bd5e`); bead closed with the full verification note. Known follow-ups were already triaged elsewhere (clippy `pomodoro_name.rs:808` → bob-cli-28; XCTest-less mac host → bob-cli-1x).

To confirm in the real app: on the Mac, run `gg` in `~/projects/github/bbugyi200/bob-mac-capture` to pull, rebuild, and reinstall; open the panel and type `:` — the Open Tasks card should appear immediately with the whole vault. If it still misbehaves, reopen with `sase bead open bob-cli-2v`.
